Scenario fixture: rgaa-field-label-consistency-review (RGAA 11.3.1)

Each target has a stable id of the form flc_case_NN. Fields of the page with the same autocomplete value but different visible labels are asked about.

01 — CANTTELL: two email fields labelled differently
02 — NOT APPLICABLE: two telephone fields labelled the same, up to case and punctuation
03 — NOT APPLICABLE: shipping and billing postal codes
